name: n8n-hubspot-support-ticket-to-product-feedback-aggregator
description: n8n workflow that scans closed and escalated HubSpot tickets, extracts feature requests, bug patterns and churn friction with an LLM, clusters similar requests, and syncs ARR-weighted product feedback records to Linear, Jira or Notion.
